name: Express Capstone GLOBAL: Sustainability + Internationalization
description: Advanced 12-quarter simulation managing a multinational across 8 global markets with dual financial and ESG/SDG scoring, geopolitical events, carbon regulation, and stakeholder governance
view:
Capstone GLOBAL

Sustainability + Internationalization Strategy

Quarter 1 of 12

Your mandate

You are Inés Mondragón, CEO of Grupo Verdia Global (home markets: Mercado Central and Región Andina). Each of 12 quarters you set sustainability investment, pricing, production mode and market entry.

The Board wants both floors met by Q12: financial at least 70 (cumulative profit and growth over a USD 3,050M quarter) and ESG at least 80 (rating and carbon intensity). Missing either caps the grade below Excellent; cumulative losses cap it at 44.

Calendar: carbon taxes start in Q5 and rise in Q9, charged on revenue by each market's regulatory pressure and your carbon intensity. Europa and Mercado del Norte buyers score suppliers on ESG; Asia buyers are price-led. Entry fees are paid at once; a new market sells from the next quarter. Watch list: trade tension in Mercado del Norte, political risk in Asia Sudeste, drought risk.

$5,000M

text.en: Evaluate a rising sustainability investment as a share of revenue against its margin cost, and diagnose when it pays off on a combined financial and ESG scorecard
text.es: Evaluar una inversión creciente en sostenibilidad como porcentaje de los ingresos frente a su coste en margen, y diagnosticar cuándo compensa en un cuadro de mando que combina resultados financieros y ESG

text.en: Analyze a carbon tax in one market and entry into a premium market, and recommend the production-mode and pricing response, including how much cost to pass through
text.es: Analizar un impuesto al carbono en un mercado y la entrada en un mercado premium, y recomendar la respuesta de modo de producción y de precios, incluida la parte del coste que se traslada

text.en: Explain why entering new markets can depress short-term results through entry costs and the timing of revenue, and what that implies for the pace of expansion
text.es: Explicar por qué entrar en nuevos mercados puede deprimir los resultados a corto plazo por los costes de entrada y el calendario de los ingresos, y qué implica para el ritmo de expansión

text.en: Analyze how a rival's ESG scandal can be turned into share gains and premium pricing without exposing the firm to the same stakeholder risk
text.es: Analizar cómo un escándalo ESG de un rival puede convertirse en ganancia de cuota y precios premium sin exponer a la empresa al mismo riesgo ante sus grupos de interés

text.en: Design a twelve-quarter market-expansion sequence that ties ESG investment to entry timing so that markets rewarding ESG fund those that do not, within the capital envelope
text.es: Diseñar una secuencia de expansión a doce trimestres que vincule la inversión ESG al calendario de entrada para que los mercados que premian la sostenibilidad financien a los que no, dentro del límite de capital

text.en: Recommend a complete twelve-quarter plan and write the shareholder-letter paragraph that frames sustainability as a demand signal rather than a cost
text.es: Recomendar un plan completo a doce trimestres y redactar el párrafo de la carta a los accionistas que presente la sostenibilidad como una señal de demanda y no como un coste

prerequisites.en: Prior courses in ESG, international market entry and regulatory strategy
prerequisites.es: Cursos previos de ESG, entrada en mercados internacionales y estrategia regulatoria
